title: Retain federation terminal diagnostics when the link-state lock is poisoned
outcome: Retain redacted first-cause diagnostics after link-state lock poisoning while preserving recover-only exact withdrawal and fail-closed admission.
acceptance: A deterministically poisoned link-state lock does not prevent the first bounded terminal diagnostic from being retained when a safe observation is available, and does not cause a second panic during unwind.
Exact owner withdrawal still occurs and the poisoned lock does not admit new link authority; focused regression and independent review cover the behavior.
